# Helia Tajabadi

### Electrical Engineering Student

I am an Electrical Engineering student at Sharif University of Technology with a growing interest in the mathematical foundations of machine learning and signal processing.

My academic interests have developed through coursework in probability, statistics, linear algebra, machine learning, and signals and systems. I am particularly interested in high-dimensional data, image processing, and probabilistic approaches to learning.

Through my coursework and projects, I have been exploring the connection between mathematical theory, computational methods, and real-world problems.
